title: Duratec Fuel Specifications
introduction:
For this Duratec reference, I use the rows that name Duratec; those entries also name Ti-VCT. The pressure specification requires the engine to be running. The separate EcoBoost/GTDi pressure row has its own low-pressure-side qualifier, so the table's engine labels matter as much as its numbers.

I treat those labels like addresses: an accurate number from the wrong row still takes you to the wrong place. Compare a reading using its matching printed unit. Tank capacity is a separate quantity, not evidence that fuel delivery is healthy. This reference does not supply pressure-test connections, pressure-release steps or fault decisions; obtain those from the matching engine procedure before testing or opening fuel plumbing.

edits.why: The engine name selects the applicable row, and the engine-running condition determines when the pressure specification applies. The capacity entries describe tank volume rather than delivery performance. An out-of-range pressure reading needs the matching diagnostic procedure before it becomes a repair decision.
